reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but separately implements occurrence-selection policy in both server handlers.

duplication.why: The daily skip-versus-move decision appears in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange, with separate occurrence-search bounds.

placement.why: Holiday recognition belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule policy also spreads into server handlers instead of remaining shared.

scope.why: The edits, tests, model extension, and release notes directly support the four requested changes.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate three implementations of the daily exception and several independently chosen search bounds when changing schedule policy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/schedules/app.ts: getDatesInRange enumerates raw RSchedule occurrences and reconstructs policy handled by shared getNextDate, while getUpcomingDates independently extends that policy.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily non-working-day exclusion is expressed as filtering in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates, but as nested conditionals and continue in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains daily-specific selection and adjustment handling; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement that daily policy.
